propositions: test_a_missing_epic_field_aborts_provisioning performs ~120 stub reads and sleeps ~120 real seconds against the production readiness budget (FIELD_READY_BUDGET_S=120.0, FIELD_POLL_INTERVAL_S=1.0) because the stub permanently omits Epic Link, forcing the poll to expire
await_required_fields always makes at least one attempt unconditionally, then breaks on monotonic() >= deadline BEFORE calling sleep, making a zero budget deterministic: exactly one poll, zero sleeps

JIRA_DC_FIELD_READY_TIMEOUT environment variable is honoured by _field_ready_timeout() as a seam to override FIELD_READY_BUDGET_S, and monkeypatching the constant would be silently defeated if that env var is already set in the ambient environment

Setting JIRA_DC_FIELD_READY_TIMEOUT=0 via monkeypatch.setenv() reduces test runtime from ~120s to <0.005s and enables a deterministic one-poll assertion that guards against regression more strongly than a timing heuristic
Production defaults and module constants remain unchanged; tests/external/live_jira_dc/conftest.py and scripts/jira_dc_field_readiness.py are unmodified
